## Objective
- Show each starter Pokémon’s sprite in the starter selection screen.

## Requirements
- Apply the requested change to the existing game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Reuse the existing procedural sprites from `creatureCanvas`.
- Display the three starters as sprite-and-type cards in the selection menu.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added starter metadata and enabled a `starters` menu layout in `js/main.js`.
- Updated `js/ui.js` to render starter sprites, names, and type details in menu entries.

### Active
- Add CSS styling for the starter selection cards and sprites.
- Run the game and verify the selection visually and functionally.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add responsive styles for `.menu-starters`, `.starter-choice`, `.starter-sprite`, `.starter-copy`, `.starter-label`, and `.starter-detail` in `style.css`.
2. Launch the game, reach the starter picker, and inspect a current JPEG screenshot.
3. Confirm keyboard and click selection still work.

## Relevant Files
- `js/main.js`: starter choices and menu options.
- `js/ui.js`: menu rendering and sprite creation.
- `js/sprites.js`: procedural `creatureCanvas` sprite factory.
- `style.css`: styles needed for the new picker layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Starter IDs are `sobble_a`, `litten_a`, and `treecko_a`; existing `creatureCanvas(id)` returns their sprites.
